name: endemico-app
description: Endémico: check-in con QR, historial, planilla y entrenamiento de la semana (prototipo El Taller Ep. 04)

scripts.db:seed: node scripts/seed.mjs > .seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute endemico --local --file=.seed.sql
scripts.db:reset: wrangler d1 execute endemico --local --file=scripts/drop.sql && npm run db:init && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:reset:remote: wrangler d1 execute endemico --remote --file=scripts/drop.sql -y && wrangler d1 execute endemico --remote --file=schema.sql -y && node scripts/seed.mjs > .seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute endemico --remote --file=.seed.sql -y
